work.description: Independent XI retains the address to Luçon’s bishop, powers to regularize or suppress confraternities, enumerated indulgence conditions and its full closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF6588–6588; the source closing at LF6705–6708 reads: Datunt Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima apr. millesimo octingen- tesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
